_meta.notice: SEED / SAMPLE DATASET FOR DEMO PURPOSES ONLY. Contains only well-documented, real, public Mumbai landmarks and market areas. No prices, ratings, review counts, capacities, or durations have been fabricated: fields the team has not verified against a primary source (official site, ASI/BMC listing, on-ground survey) are left as null rather than guessed, per the project's no-fabrication rule. Before the hackathon demo or any production use, replace/extend this with the team's own researched provider dataset (restaurants, cafes, individual shops, tour operators, festivals/events) — this file intentionally does NOT invent specific businesses, vendors, or tour operators.

places.address: Shahid Bhagat Singh Road, Colaba, Mumbai
places.description: A long, busy street market in Colaba known for clothing, accessories, jewelry, souvenirs and handicrafts stalls; a popular spot for local and tourist shopping.
places.experience_tags: shopping, souvenirs, local experience, street market, bargaining
places.opening_hours: Typically daytime into early evening; exact vendor hours vary

places.address: Lokmanya Tilak Road, near Dhobi Talao, Fort, Mumbai
places.description: A historic covered market (built in the 1860s) selling fruit, spices, household goods, pets and general merchandise; a well-known Mumbai heritage shopping landmark.
places.experience_tags: shopping, local market, heritage building, spices, fruit
places.opening_hours: Daytime; closed on Sundays for wholesale trading (retail sections vary)

places.address: Mutton Street, Null Bazaar area, Mumbai
places.description: One of Mumbai's oldest flea markets, known for antiques, vintage furniture, old Bollywood memorabilia, curios and secondhand goods.
places.experience_tags: shopping, antiques, vintage, local experience, bargaining, hidden gem

places.description: A heritage arts precinct with art galleries (e.g. Jehangir Art Gallery), museums nearby, boutique stores and street art; hosts the annual Kala Ghoda Arts Festival.
places.experience_tags: culture, art, galleries, heritage walk, local experience
places.cost_basis: Free to walk around; individual gallery/event entry varies
places.opening_hours: Precinct accessible during daytime; individual galleries have their own hours

places.description: An iconic early-20th-century archway monument overlooking the Arabian Sea, and the departure point for ferries to Elephanta Island.
places.cost_basis: Free entry to view; no ticket required

places.sub_category: UNESCO World Heritage Site / rock-cut caves
places.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site of ancient rock-cut cave temples dedicated to Shiva, reached by ferry from the Gateway of India.
places.experience_tags: heritage, UNESCO, caves, ferry trip, day trip
places.cost_basis: Ticketed entry (Archaeological Survey of India) plus a separate ferry fare; current amounts not verified in this dataset
places.opening_hours: Closed on Mondays (site); ferry schedules vary

places.provider_name: Mohammed Ali Road Street Food Area
places.address: Mohammed Ali Road, near Crawford Market, Mumbai
places.description: A well-known street-food stretch with numerous stalls, especially busy and popular in the evenings and during Ramadan; offers a range of local non-vegetarian and dessert specialties.
places.experience_tags: street food, local food, evening food walk, local experience
places.cost_basis: Pay per item at individual stalls; amount not verified in this dataset
places.opening_hours: Primarily evening into night; especially busy during Ramadan

places.provider_name: Khau Gully (CSMT area street food lane)
places.address: Near Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), Fort, Mumbai
places.description: A cluster of street-food stalls near CSMT popular with office-goers and visitors for quick local snacks.
places.experience_tags: street food, local food, quick bite, local experience
places.cost_basis: Pay per item at individual stalls; amount not verified in this dataset

places.description: A mosque and dargah (shrine) built on an islet off the coast of Worli, connected to the mainland by a causeway walkway that is only accessible at low tide.
places.experience_tags: religious, spiritual, heritage, waterfront, causeway walk
places.opening_hours: Open daily; causeway access depends on tide timings

places.address: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Road, Mumbai
places.description: A 3.6 km curved boulevard along the Arabian Sea coast, nicknamed the 'Queen's Necklace' for how its streetlights look at night; popular for evening walks and sunset views.
places.experience_tags: waterfront, sunset, evening walk, local experience, must-visit
places.opening_hours: Open all day; most popular at sunset/evening
